title: Care & Reuse Tips
excerpt: Non-woven bags last longer when used correctly. Quick Care Tips Good bags + good usage = long-term value.
content:
Non-woven bags last longer when used correctly.

Quick Care Tips

  • Avoid overloading beyond intended weight
  • Keep away from high heat
  • Store dry after use
  • For dust: wipe with dry cloth
  • For mild stains: gentle wipe with damp cloth

Good bags + good usage = long-term value.

title: Best Bag Types Explained (D-cut, W-cut, Loop, Box)
excerpt: Different businesses need different bag styles. Here’s a quick guide: D-Cut Bags W-Cut / Shopping Bags Loop Handle Bags Box
content:
Different businesses need different bag styles. Here’s a quick guide:

D-Cut Bags

  • Budget-friendly, simple
  • Best for: medical, small retail, takeaway

W-Cut / Shopping Bags

  • Strong base, stands well
  • Best for: supermarkets, textile, general retail

Loop Handle Bags

  • Premium feel, reusable
  • Best for: boutiques, premium stores, gifting

Box Bags

  • Structured and premium
  • Best for: gifts, events, premium packaging

Choosing the right style improves carrying comfort and makes your brand look premium.

title: Custom Printing Guide
excerpt: Custom printed bags work best when the artwork is clean and print-ready. What You Should Prepare Design Tips Approval Process
content:
Custom printed bags work best when the artwork is clean and print-ready.

What You Should Prepare

  • Logo file in PDF/AI/CDR or high-res PNG
  • Brand colors (HEX / CMYK if available)
  • Preferred bag color (white, black, etc.)
  • Print area preference (front/back)

Design Tips

  • Keep text minimal; bold logos look best
  • Use high contrast (dark logo on light bag, or vice versa)
  • Avoid tiny details that may blur in printing

Approval Process

Before production, you should confirm:

  • Final artwork
  • Bag size & handle style
  • GSM & quantity
  • Delivery timeline

title: How to Choose GSM for Non-Woven Bags
excerpt: How to Choose GSM for Non-Woven Bags GSM means “grams per square meter”—it indicates how thick and strong the bag
content:
How to Choose GSM for Non-Woven Bags

GSM means “grams per square meter”—it indicates how thick and strong the bag fabric is. Higher GSM usually means higher durability and a more premium look.

Quick GSM Guide

400 GSM

  • Lightweight and economical
  • Good for: promotions, light retail items, takeaway packaging

700 GSM

  • Balanced strength + cost
  • Good for: boutiques, general retail, garments, medium loads

900 GSM

  • Premium strength and better finish
  • Good for: supermarkets, textile showrooms, larger carry needs

1400 GSM

  • Heavy-duty, premium feel
  • Good for: bulk shopping, repeated reuse, premium brand packaging

How to Decide

  • If you want lowest cost → 400 GSM
  • If you want best value + durability → 700 GSM
  • If you want premium feel → 900 GSM
  • If you want maximum strength → 1400 GSM

Pro Tip: If printing matters, slightly higher GSM gives better structure and a more premium presentation.

title: Non-Woven Bags vs Plastic Bags
excerpt: Plastic bags may look cheap upfront, but they often cost more in the long run—especially when customers don’t reuse them
content:
Plastic bags may look cheap upfront, but they often cost more in the long run—especially when customers don’t reuse them and your brand visibility ends the moment they leave your store.

Non-woven bags are made for repeat use. That means your customer carries your brand again and again—on buses, in markets, and at home.

Differences

1) Durability
Non-woven bags can handle daily-use loads better than thin plastic bags. Great for groceries, textiles, and retail packaging.

2) Branding
Non-woven bags give you a premium feel. Printing looks clean and professional, which improves brand perception.

3) Customer Experience
Customers prefer strong bags they can reuse. It reduces complaints and improves satisfaction.

4) Environmental Impact
Reducing single-use plastics is a major shift across India. Non-woven bags are widely adopted as a better alternative.

Best Use Cases for Non-Woven Bags

  • Supermarkets & provision stores
  • Textile & boutique packaging
  • Events, temples, and functions
  • Medical shops and pharmacies
